description:
Return version-aware feature flags for the installed Photoshop (Select Subject v2, Generative Fill, etc.).

Use when: once per session before suggesting AI-powered features or gated recipes.
Do NOT use when: Photoshop version is already known from photoshop_get_version.

Returns: JSON { version, features: { select_subject_v2, generative_fill, ... } }.
Preconditions: none. Side effects: none.
name: photoshop_get_capabilities
